title: Workspace
description: A builder's workspace: one instance of the system. A naive-workspace.json (earlier workspace.json) at its top says which schema version it follows, where its vault is and where its repositories are (EE-002, EE-011, EE-020). A workspace always has a vault; it has a code folder of repositories once any venture builds software. One schema covers both file names; naive-workspace.json is the name create-venture writes. A teammate's own workspace can list ventures they work for or with; each venture keeps its own settings, and the workspace's settings govern what crosses between them.

schema_version.description: The version in schema/VERSION that this workspace follows

name.description: The workspace's name, shown to the founder. A new workspace is named "Naive workspace"; the founder renames it with naive workspace rename

ventures.description: Folders to search for venture.json files, relative to the workspace. Grouping folders inside them are for people to browse and carry no meaning; each venture.json is the truth.

code.description: The folder holding the ventures' repositories (repository, short repo: a version-controlled store, normally Git, for code and the documents that ship with it). Needed once any venture builds software

vault.description: The vault: the folder of documents (Markdown and JSON records) that holds the venture folders, their records and their decisions. Relative to the workspace; defaults to the workspace itself. Any notes app can open it; Obsidian calls such a folder a vault

settings.description: The workspace's own configuration, set by the founder. Offline (a local folder) these are the whole of it.

cross_venture_reads.description: Whether a session in one venture may read another venture in this workspace. Only published artifacts ever cross; records and _private/ never do. On unless the founder turns it off

route_threshold.description: How sure naive capture must be before it files a chunk in a venture's inbox by itself; below it the chunk waits in the workspace inbox for the founder

founder.description: The founder record, relative to the workspace (normally founders/<handle>/founder.json, schema/founders.ts)

timeZone.description: The workspace's IANA time zone (for example America/New_York): the clock's zone (schema/clock.mjs). Set when the workspace is initiated, from the system's zone unless given; a venture.json timeZone overrides it for that venture

calendar.description: The calendar folder, relative to the workspace (calendar/): calendars/<id>.json and events/<uid>.json (schema/calendar.mjs). Created with the workspace
